recognize_zh: 瀰漫性浸潤的腫瘤細胞中，只有一部分呈中度到強度膜狀 CD5 陽性，其餘細胞陰性；T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤的 CD5 表現本就不一致，部分喪失並不排除 T 系。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of closely packed cells with scant cytoplasm
Membranous CD5 staining in a subset of cells, moderate to strong, with many negative cells
Patchy and heterogeneous staining distribution across the field
Entrapped negative non-lymphoid structures (possibly vessels or residual epithelium) on the right
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD5 shows moderate to strong membranous positivity in a subset of the infiltrating cells, with a substantial proportion negative. Entrapped CD5-negative non-hematopoietic structures are present. Partial CD5 expression is common in T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma and, when interpreted with CD3, TdT and CD1a, supports T lineage; distinction of positive tumor cells from admixed reactive T cells requires correlation with the other stains.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells are small mature CD5+ lymphocytes that are TdT-negative and CD1a-negative.
Blastoid MCL is CD5+ but B-lineage (CD20+, PAX5+), cyclin D1+ and SOX11+, and lacks CD3 and TdT.
Thymocytes in thymoma are CD5+ and TdT+ but are mixed with a cytokeratin-positive epithelial network.
